initial_query: I am looking for an existing commercial unit. I intend to assess a conversion into a play space / baby parking (hourly childcare), subject to confirmation of the applicable authorization regime. I need a property with at least 115 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 15 people. I prefer a property in energy class D or better. I prefer properties near parks.
submitted_query: I am looking for an existing commercial unit. I intend to assess a conversion into a play space / baby parking (hourly childcare), subject to confirmation of the applicable authorization regime. I need a property with at least 115 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 15 people. I prefer a property in energy class D or better. I prefer properties near parks.
final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type = 'Commercial activities and similar'
  AND surface_area >= 115
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D')
  AND green >= 89
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.4965445, 9.1571426) ASC
